alreadyOpen.description: Faces that already have an open request.

noSource.description: Low faces where nothing can be moved: no usable reserve stock, or less than one multiple fits.

requestIds.description: The requests raised, in forward-bin order.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, or an invalid path, query or header parameter.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body or unknown field

value.title: Malformed request
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Policy is invalid
value.detail: minQty must be at least 0 and below maxQty, and multiple at least 1

value.title: Request id is invalid
value.detail: request id must start with repl- and have no whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: If-Match is invalid
value.detail: If-Match must be a policy version, a non-negative integer

value.title: State is invalid
value.detail: state must be one of Requested, Completed, Cancelled

value.title: Status is invalid
value.detail: status must be one of BELOW_MIN, OK, NO_SOURCE, NO_POLICY

value.title: Cursor is invalid
value.detail: cursor is not a value returned by this API

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

422.description: The request is well-formed but the current state does not allow it, or the Idempotency-Key was reused.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

idempotencyKeyReused.summary: The Idempotency-Key was used with a different body

value.title: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key was used with a different request body

noForwardAssignment.summary: The SKU has no forward bin

value.title: The SKU has no forward pick face at this site
value.detail: the site's approved slot plan assigns no forward bin to this SKU

value.title: The SKU has no replenishment policy at this site
value.detail: declare a policy with PUT /policies/{siteId}/{sku} first

noSourceStock.summary: No reserve bin can supply the quantity

value.title: No reserve bin can supply this quantity
value.detail: no reserve bin of the site holds usable stock of this SKU for the requested quantity

nothingToReplenish.summary: The pick face is above its minimum and no quantity was given

value.title: The pick face does not need replenishment
value.detail: the pick face is above its minimum; send a quantity to replenish it anyway

quantityExceedsMax.summary: The quantity would overfill the pick face

value.title: The quantity would exceed the policy maximum
value.detail: projected level plus quantity must not exceed maxQty
